name: business_memberships
sql:
CREATE TABLE business_memberships (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  business_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  role TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'admin',
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  UNIQUE(user_id, business_id),
  FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id),
  FOREIGN KEY (business_id) REFERENCES businesses(id)
)

name: business_settings
sql:
CREATE TABLE business_settings (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  business_id INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  operating_hours TEXT,
  contact_email TEXT,
  phone TEXT,
  address TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  FOREIGN KEY (business_id) REFERENCES businesses(id)
)

name: businesses
sql:
CREATE TABLE businesses (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  owner_user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  business_type TEXT NOT NULL,
  currency TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ZAR',
  timezone TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Africa/Johannesburg',
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  FOREIGN KEY (owner_user_id) REFERENCES users(id)
)

name: customers
sql:
CREATE TABLE customers (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  business_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  email TEXT,
  phone TEXT,
  loyalty_points INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  FOREIGN KEY (business_id) REFERENCES businesses(id),
  UNIQUE (business_id, email)
)

name: global_product_catalogue
sql:
CREATE TABLE global_product_catalogue (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  product_name TEXT NOT NULL,
  brand TEXT,
  packaging_size TEXT,
  category TEXT,
  description TEXT,
  verification_status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'incomplete' CHECK (verification_status IN ('incomplete', 'verified')),
  data_source TEXT NOT NULL,
  date_added TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  verified_at TEXT
)

name: inventory
sql:
CREATE TABLE inventory (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  business_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  product_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  quantity_on_hand INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (quantity_on_hand >= 0),
  reorder_level INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (reorder_level >= 0),
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  UNIQUE (business_id, product_id),
  FOREIGN KEY (business_id) REFERENCES businesses(id),
  FOREIGN KEY (product_id) REFERENCES products(id)
)

name: inventory_movements
sql:
CREATE TABLE inventory_movements (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  business_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  product_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  movement_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (movement_type IN ('opening', 'receipt', 'sale', 'refund', 'adjustment')),
  quantity INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (quantity <> 0),
  reference_type TEXT,
  reference_id INTEGER,
  notes TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  FOREIGN KEY (business_id) REFERENCES businesses(id),
  FOREIGN KEY (product_id) REFERENCES products(id)
)

name: product_barcode_duplicate_archive
sql:
CREATE TABLE product_barcode_duplicate_archive (
  archive_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  original_barcode_record_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  global_product_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  barcode TEXT NOT NULL,
  barcode_format TEXT NOT NULL,
  data_source TEXT NOT NULL,
  verification_status TEXT NOT NULL,
  date_added TEXT NOT NULL,
  verified_at TEXT,
  archived_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
)

name: product_barcodes
sql:
CREATE TABLE product_barcodes (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  global_product_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  barcode TEXT NOT NULL,
  barcode_format TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (barcode_format IN ('EAN-13', 'EAN-8', 'UPC-A')),
  data_source TEXT NOT NULL,
  verification_status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unverified' CHECK (verification_status IN ('unverified', 'verified')),
  date_added TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  verified_at TEXT,
  FOREIGN KEY (global_product_id) REFERENCES global_product_catalogue(id)
)

name: products
sql:
CREATE TABLE products (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  business_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  sku TEXT,
  category TEXT,
  price_cents INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  cost_cents INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  is_active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (is_active IN (0, 1)),
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, cost_is_known INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (cost_is_known IN (0, 1)), brand TEXT, barcode TEXT, barcode_status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unverified' CHECK (barcode_status IN ('unverified', 'verified')), description TEXT, packaging_size TEXT, global_catalogue_id INTEGER REFERENCES global_product_catalogue(id), unit_of_measure TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unit', image_url TEXT,
  FOREIGN KEY (business_id) REFERENCES businesses(id),
  UNIQUE (business_id, sku)
)

name: sale_items
sql:
CREATE TABLE sale_items (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  sale_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  product_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  product_name_snapshot TEXT NOT NULL,
  product_category_snapshot TEXT,
  quantity INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (quantity > 0),
  unit_price_cents INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (unit_price_cents >= 0),
  unit_cost_cents INTEGER,
  line_total_cents INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (line_total_cents >= 0),
  FOREIGN KEY (sale_id) REFERENCES sales(id),
  FOREIGN KEY (product_id) REFERENCES products(id),
  CHECK (unit_cost_cents IS NULL OR unit_cost_cents >= 0)
)

name: sales
sql:
CREATE TABLE sales (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  business_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  customer_id INTEGER,
  transaction_reference TEXT NOT NULL,
  idempotency_key TEXT,
  subtotal_cents INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (subtotal_cents >= 0),
  discount_cents INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (discount_cents >= 0),
  tax_cents INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (tax_cents >= 0),
  total_cents INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (total_cents >= 0),
  payment_method TEXT,
  status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'completed' CHECK (status IN ('completed', 'refunded', 'cancelled')),
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  FOREIGN KEY (business_id) REFERENCES businesses(id),
  FOREIGN KEY (customer_id) REFERENCES customers(id)
)

name: schema_migrations
sql:
CREATE TABLE schema_migrations (
      version TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      checksum TEXT NOT NULL,
      applied_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
    )

name: sessions
sql:
CREATE TABLE sessions (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  business_id INTEGER,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  expires_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id),
  FOREIGN KEY (business_id) REFERENCES businesses(id)
)

name: users
sql:
CREATE TABLE users (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  email TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  password_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
  first_name TEXT,
  last_name TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
)
